'''Cactoczar''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cactobloom]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "At some point, Cactoczar realized that picking on Zobos is even more fun than pranking Tatari. After all, no matter how angry they get, they can't get close enough to strike back."

Cactoczar is a red rarity Tatari.

== Appearance ==
A green cactus creature with tiny eyes and pink flowers on its head and arms. It stands bipedal on short legs and has a zig-zag shaped mouth.

Cactoczar's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form is bright cyan instead of green.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Cactoczar once held a sign that said 'free hugs' and waited 2 hours in the street. Only Zobos cared."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Shoots spines enthusiastically into opponents during combat. The pain and itchiness that follow are a great source of happiness for Cactoczar."
